verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-sharing and remote-control app. A product of that kind could plausibly offer a programmatic or scripting interface, so the API-parity axis applies. The evidence documents only UI and touch features, a Homebrew install, and a command-line host runner for development and testing. It shows no API that mirrors UI functionality, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all return 404.
